description: This file defines the 'ExecAllowlistMatcher' enum with static methods for matching executable entries against command resolutions, including pattern validation, matching, and regex generation.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches a list of entries against a command resolution, returning the first matching entry or nil.

methods.name: matchAll
methods.description: Matches multiple command resolutions against a list of entries, returning all matches.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a target string matches a pattern using regex.

methods.name: normalizeMatchTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a string for matching by replacing backslashes with slashes and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: regex
methods.description: Generates a regex object from a pattern string, supporting wildcards.
